45% of people with $1,000+ saved won’t invest any of it this year (YouGov, 2026).\
\
The top reason: they don’t think they can afford it. \
\
If you’re still building an emergency fund,  that is the right call.  But waiting does have a price.\
\
Per the SEC, saving $500K by 65 takes $209\/month if you start at 25, and $441\/month if you start at 35, assuming a 7% average annual return rate.\
